## Evidence
- [ ] Tests written first; RED evidence attached
- [ ] GREEN/REFACTOR test outputs attached, or blockers explained
- [ ] Unit/integration/E2E/security checks appropriate to change
- [ ] Authorization, organization scope, redaction checked
- [ ] No secrets, real PII or unsafe migrations
- [ ] Docs, traceability, tasks updated

## Deployment / migrations
Describe changes, compatibility and rollback/forward-fix. No autonomous deployment.
